name: sidecr
description: Sidecr: a companion window for the herdr terminal multiplexer
author: Nazzareno Giannelli

scripts.build:ui: bun build ui/app.ts ui/lightbox.ts --outdir dist --target browser
scripts.build:shell:test: cd shell/src-tauri && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-test cargo tauri build --no-bundle --config tauri.test.conf.json
scripts.demo:hero: python demo/fixture.py && bun run build:ui && bun demo/capture.ts && bun demo/compose.ts
